title: Christmas Mug Ornament SVG Bundle
author: WoodNova
description:
Description
Add a fun and cozy touch to your Christmas tree with this adorable Christmas Ornament SVG Bundle! This collection features five festive Christmas mug ornaments — Santa, Penguin, Reindeer, Snowman, and Gingerbread — decorated with whipped cream, candy canes, scarves, holly, bows, and other cheerful holiday details.
These cute layered designs are perfect for creating Christmas tree ornaments, personalized holiday decorations, handmade Christmas gifts, craft fair products, ornament exchanges, and DIY laser-cut projects.
🎄 Design Features
Santa Claus Christmas mug ornament
Cute penguin Christmas mug ornament
Reindeer Christmas mug ornament
Snowman Christmas mug ornament
Gingerbread Christmas mug ornament
Whipped cream and candy cane details
Festive scarves, bows and holly accents
Cute Christmas coffee cup theme
Layered 3D wood-style appearance
Designed for hanging Christmas tree decorations
Perfect for personalized Christmas gifts
Suitable for wood, MDF and acrylic
Clean laser-cut design elements
📁 File Formats Included
SVG
AI
EPS
DXF
DWG
PDF
⚙️ Compatible With
Glowforge, xTool, LightBurn, OMTech, Thunder Laser, Aeon Laser, Cricut, Silhouette Designer Edition, and most cutting machines/software that support SVG or DXF files.
